subject: Pre-bill readiness pulse — Acme Therapeutics (PO timing & invoice gating)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Kline <laura.kline@acme-thera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Pre-bill readiness pulse — Acme Therapeutics (PO timing & invoice gating)

Hi Laura —

Following up from last week's call to lock the PO / invoicing path so we can recognize November bookings on our side. Finance flagged two gating items before we can schedule the first invoice: 1) a signed PO referencing the contract ID, and 2) the milestone payment table that maps to recognized milestones for revenue booking.

Can you confirm whether procurement will issue the PO by COB Wednesday (12/1)? If there's any internal approval hurdle on your end (SOW amendment, legal redlines), please call that out so we can align our billing cadence.

Quick checklist we will need on receipt of PO:
- PO referencing Redwood contract: RWI-ACME-114
- Total amount and billing contacts (name + email)
- Invoicing frequency (monthly / milestone) and first invoice date
- Any required payment terms (Net30/Net45) and billing address

I attached our standard PO template for convenience. If you prefer, we can accept a one-line PO + DocuSign SOW amendment.

Thanks — appreciate a quick note so I can update Finance and the forecast commit.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Acme-PO-template.pdf
From: Laura Kline <laura.kline@acme-thera.com>

Cc: procurement@acme-thera.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-bill readiness pulse — Acme Therapeutics (PO timing & invoice gating)

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Procurement confirms they can issue a PO but legal needs to append a short SOW amendment referencing the AI usage clause. That approval path is expected to clear by Tues 11/30 EOD; procurement tentatively expects to issue the PO on Wed 12/1.

Two notes:
- Can you accept a PO that references our master agreement number (MT-ACME-2024) instead of the Redwood contract number? Legal prefers referencing the master agreement + SOW amendment rather than the vendor contract ID.
- Invoice frequency: we prefer milestone invoices mapped to delivery milestones — can you send the milestone payment table?

I'll loop procurement directly (cc'd).

Best,
Laura Kline
Head of Procurement, Acme Therapeutics
laura.kline@acme-thera.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-bill readiness pulse — Acme Therapeutics (PO timing & invoice gating)

Laura — perfect, thanks for the timing. Two quick clarifications so Finance has everything they need:

1) Master agreement reference: we can accept MT-ACME-2024 in the PO; please ask procurement to include the DocuSign SOW amendment ID in the PO notes so internal auditors can trace the change.

2) Milestone table: attaching a lightweight payment schedule (CSV) here — shows milestone name, deliverable, percent of order, and expected invoice trigger. If you prefer any different naming or mapping, tell me and we'll update immediately.

3) Forecasting ask: if procurement signs for Wed 12/1, can we treat the contract as a forecast commit for Finance on 12/2? We want to avoid over-committing until the signed PO is in hand, but a 12/1 PO would allow us to include November bookings in the November close window (per our revenue ops timeline).

I'll hold on the MOP until procurement confirms the PO language; Ben and Vanessa will flag any accounting implications.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Looping in our finance-facing notes here. Stephanie — I updated the HubSpot deal with the PO expected date (12/01/2026) and marked stage: PO pending. I attached the MOP we discussed with percentages tied to product delivery windows. If procurement confirms master agreement referencing and includes the DocuSign SOW id, Accounting is comfortable recognizing the booking for Nov as long as the signed PO arrives by 12/1 end of day.

A few practical items for the invoice team:
- Billing contact to appear on PO (name + email) so AP can send invoices to the right inbox.
- If payment term is Net45 we need to include that in the revenue recognition model — please confirm.
- Any tax forms or W9-like documents from Acme need to be on file before payment processing.

Thanks team — good cadence. Summary / next steps for Finance commit review and forecasting: 

1) Acme procurement to issue PO referencing MT-ACME-2024 + DocuSign SOW ID by 12/01 EOD (Laura to confirm).
2) On PO receipt: Accounting to accept PO and trigger first invoice per milestone table.
3) If PO arrives 12/01, Revenue Ops (Ben) to mark the deal as Commit for November close; Marissa, please coordinate the forecast adjustment in the weekly finance checkpoint.

Marissa: can you run the fast-check on recognition entries and notify Accounting if any deferred revenue entries need to be prepped? We want to avoid last-minute cutover errors.

Laura — appreciate the speed. If procurement needs any wording tweaks on the PO template, reply inline and we'll update the template immediately.

-Vanessa
